events.subtitle: with Uniform
events.category: Culturally significant heavy music / comeback-era post-metal
events.factual_description: Ticketmaster lists Neurosis with Uniform at Warsaw in Brooklyn on Friday, October 30, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM, an 8:00 PM show, all-ages admission, and general admission only. Neurosis' official March 2026 announcement states that An Undying Love for a Burning World is the band's first new album in a decade, that Aaron Turner joined on guitar and vocals alongside Steve Von Till, Jason Roeder, Dave Edwardson, and Noah Landis, and that the band's July 2026 Fire in the Mountains appearance would be its first stage show in seven years. Pitchfork's September 9 tour announcement independently lists the October 30 Warsaw date with Uniform as part of the new U.S. run. Warsaw's official visitor page identifies the venue at 261 Driggs Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11222.

en.why_it_matters: Neurosis is not simply putting an old catalog back on the road. These Brooklyn dates belong to the first live chapter after seven years away from the stage and the first album cycle with Aaron Turner inside the band, a change that puts his guitar and voice into one of heavy music's most distinctive architectures of repetition, distortion, dynamics, and release. Friday adds Uniform, sharpening the night toward industrial pressure and noise. This is a strong reason to make room for Warsaw if New York is in play.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York weekend is already plausible, build Friday night around Warsaw; the Greenpoint setting and Uniform pairing make it a particularly coherent heavy-music night. From the DMV, I would combine it with another New York reason rather than make a dedicated corridor trip solely for this date, especially because Neurosis plays the same room again the next night.

es.why_it_matters: Neurosis no está simplemente sacando el catálogo viejo de gira. Estas fechas de Brooklyn pertenecen al primer capítulo en vivo después de siete años fuera de los escenarios y al primer ciclo de álbum con Aaron Turner dentro de la banda, un cambio que mete su guitarra y su voz en una de las arquitecturas más reconocibles de la música pesada: repetición, distorsión, dinámica y descarga. El viernes suma a Uniform y empuja la noche hacia la presión industrial y el ruido. Si Nueva York está en juego, hay una razón fuerte para hacer espacio para Warsaw.
es.trip_verdict: Si un fin de semana en Nueva York ya es plausible, armaría el viernes alrededor de Warsaw; Greenpoint y el cruce con Uniform hacen una noche de música pesada particularmente coherente. Desde el DMV lo combinaría con otra razón para subir, en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado sólo por esta fecha, sobre todo porque Neurosis repite en la misma sala al día siguiente.
